about: Judge probe for Suite B: synthetic cues written for known reference facts. Positives (a paraphrase that keeps every idea, using descriptions instead of names; the fact plus an extra detail) must be credited to their fact; near misses (wrong count, colour or value, swapped character, gist only, invented detail in place of the fact's own) must not. Facts are taken from the committed facts outside the smoke clip (Elephants Dream 60-150 s). The cues of a group are shown in a fixed shuffled order (seed below), under the pinned judge prompt, like any run's cues.
